Shows the days and hours until National Day and its official holiday.

How many days left?

About Kuwait National Day

25 February celebrates National Day and Kuwait's independence in 1961, and 26 February Liberation Day in 1991.

Frequently asked questions

When is Kuwait National Day 2027?

Thursday 25 February 2027, followed by Liberation Day on Friday 26 February.

How long is the National and Liberation Day holiday?

Two days under the Labour Law, 25 and 26 February; working on them earns extra pay.

  • Kuwait — text of Labour Law 6/2010 (Al Anba, Arabic)
